4) Offer virtual I-9 via authorized agent list; fallback: notarized verification at local service if needed.
Any blockers?

Sarah: SGTM — I'll ping Aisha now and include the BG upload link. Will let her know about restricted access until cleared.

Kevin (IT): :thumbsup: Starting provisioning now. I'll drop the Okta invite link here when ready and mark the account as 'contingent'.
